title: Cyclic interval strips on both axes: conditional κ = 8.578151200855e-5
body:
**Full verification passed.** Full verification passed on `fb550b9b1a3c60cc419701e530494ed754d08cef` in 2409.831 seconds, completed 2026-10-09T00:45:01.380047+00:00: `make -j1 verify` (78 isolated test modules and 20 historical patch checks), both producer regenerations, exact assembly and six adversarial controls. All 39 research-head GitHub checks passed; no source drift. See `research/cyclic-strips-both-axes/validation.json` for evidence hashes.

**Live comparison:** PR #110 appeared during submission and reports κ = 8.58478×10⁻⁵, about 0.07728% above this candidate. This PR therefore makes no current-record claim. Its cyclic-strip construction may be compatible with #110's deferred readouts, but that combination has not been verified.

Under all of PR104's inherited and newly proposed interfaces (as used by #107–#109), T(n)=O(n(log n)^(1−κ)) with **κ = 1715630240171/(2·10^16) = 8.578151200855×10⁻⁵**, **7.278% above #109** (7.9961717358×10⁻⁵), 7.384% above #108, 9.999% above #107.

**Idea.** Both axes of #104 compute leave-one-out strip sums with s_j = A_{j−1}+B_{j+1}. We replace them with **cyclic interval strips** (#62's construction from the frame-compiler lineage): build every cyclic interval I(a,m)=I(a,m−1)+v_{a+m−1}; s_j is the complementary interval. Every interval has a later consumer with a containing cover, so the **unchanged** carrier matchers join far more additions.

- Bit axis: only `PairedExclusionCircuit.block`'s strip layout (cyclic, carry last), loaded privately; positive labels recomputed by the unchanged labeler; positive matching = envelope matching.
- Complex axis: PairedTriple strips cyclic; pair stars keep #108's dual-suffix identity; coordinate order back to #104's `((i^1) in (a,b), i)`.
- Bit parameter rule, divisor 21, rational scatter, copied centers, bridge and assembly unchanged. The complex leaf still binds (≈4.7% below the new bit cap).

**Checks:** `research/cyclic-strips-both-axes/verify.py` regenerates both rows from source with every exact support/center/scatter/frame assertion and the unchanged matchers; certifies the stopped coarse moment (rejects COARSE+10⁻¹³), the strict complex moment (rejects b+10⁻¹⁴), all 47 constraints and 7 margins (rejects κ+10⁻¹⁷). `test_controls.py` rejects the #104 bit row, the #108 complex row, unpaid cleanup, omitted loss and an unpaid role on the mathematics alone (certificate comparison disabled), and accepts the selected rows. 336 source pins.

Scope: finite conditional witness; #104's opposite-bank factorization, stopped streaming and odd-denominator grid interfaces remain written proof dependencies. No optimality/runtime claim.

Credit: icekylinx (#104), Avi Eisenberg (#62 intervals, #53), Rohan Gupta / gupt1156 (#55 dual-suffix strips), #107–#109, and all predecessors in #104's NOTICE/SOURCES. Prepared by Rohan Arun with Anthropic Claude assistance.


Independent local verification of `fb550b9b1a3c60cc419701e530494ed754d08cef` also passed: both producer rows regenerated, exact assembly and three next-grid checks passed, and all six adversarial controls passed. Full repository verification is now complete; see the committed receipt.
